name: Feishu
description: Deliver run notifications to Feishu/Lark and trigger configured routines from app events.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.help: Per-tenant overrides; every key falls back to the top level.

allowFrom.label: Allowed DM senders
allowFrom.help: Empty means no allowlist. "*" is only honored with dmPolicy open.

appSecret.label: App secret
appSecret.help: Feishu self-built app secret; prefer env:FEISHU_APP_SECRET.

connectionMode.label: Event transport
connectionMode.help: websocket (default) dials out to Feishu and needs no public URL; webhook receives Feishu's HTTP callback.

defaultAccount.label: Default account
defaultAccount.help: Account used by notifications.routes[].account when it is omitted.

dmPolicy.label: Direct message policy
dmPolicy.help: pairing (default) replies with a pairing code, allowlist checks allowFrom, open requires allowFrom ["*"].

domain.label: Tenant domain
domain.help: feishu (default), lark, or an explicit base URL such as https://open.larksuite.com.

encryptKey.label: Encrypt key
encryptKey.help: Verifies X-Lark-Signature and decrypts encrypted events; prefer env:FEISHU_ENCRYPT_KEY.

groupPolicy.label: Group policy
groupPolicy.help: allowlist (default), open, or disabled. open means no mention is required.

groups.label: Per-chat overrides
groups.help: groups.<chat_id> overrides enabled / requireMention / allowFrom for one chat.

inbound.label: Inbound events
inbound.help: Routing for accepted events; the message text is never interpreted.

inbound.routine.label: Routine
inbound.routine.help: Routine started by an accepted message, menu click, or card action.

inbound.tasks.label: Tasks
inbound.tasks.help: Used when no routine is configured.

requireMention.label: Require a mention
requireMention.help: Defaults to true unless the effective group policy is open.

targets.label: Targets
targets.help: Named chat destinations referenced by notifications.routes[].target.

verificationToken.label: Verification token
verificationToken.help: Required in webhook mode; prefer env:FEISHU_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.

webhookHost.label: Callback host
webhookHost.help: Bind host of openclaw's own callback server; Giclaw reuses the web server.

webhookPath.label: Callback path
webhookPath.help: Default /feishu/events; mounted only in webhook mode.

webhookPort.label: Callback port
webhookPort.help: Bind port of openclaw's own callback server; Giclaw reuses web.port.

defaultAccount.description: Must match a key of accounts when accounts is present.

connectionMode.description: Inbound event transport (default websocket: no public URL needed).

domain.description: Tenant origin: feishu (default), lark, or an explicit base URL. Use https://open.larksuite.com for Lark.

webhookPath.description: HTTP callback path; default /feishu/events. Only used in webhook mode.

inbound.description: Event routing; webhook mode additionally requires both encryptKey and verificationToken.

mode.description: Defaults to app when appId+appSecret are set, otherwise webhook.

chatId.description: Feishu chat id (oc_xxx) or any id of the declared receiveIdType.

webhookUrl.description: Per-target custom-bot webhook; overrides the plugin-level webhookUrl.

card.description: Send an interactive card (default) instead of plain text.

dmPolicy.description: Direct-message policy; open additionally requires allowFrom to contain "*".

groupPolicy.description: allowall is an alias of open.

allowBots.description: Accept events sent by another bot.

webhookHost.description: Bind host of openclaw's own callback server; Giclaw reuses the web server.

webhookPort.description: Bind port of openclaw's own callback server; Giclaw reuses web.port.

accounts.description: Per-tenant overrides. An account key accepts every top-level key except `accounts` and `defaultAccount`; anything it omits is inherited from the top level.
